ns2:section.sectionText: IMPORTANT DETAILS; PLEASE READ CLOSELY. This section is restricted to Juniors and students in the M.Arch 2+ program only. The Architecture in Barcelona and Chicago (ABC) Studio focuses on urbanism and/or housing (affordable or simply collective housing). It is a travel studio running for six weeks in June and July. It begins with two weeks in Barcelona followed by four weeks in Chicago and features leading faculty from the University of Illinois as well as numerous guests and site visits. For 2025, the approximate dates are June 08-24 in Barcelona and June 24-July 25 in Chicago. Find more details and apply at https://app.studyabroad.illinois.edu/index.cfm?FuseAction=Programs.ViewProgram&Program_ID=11957. In addition to applying, you must register for this course to receive course credit.
